data.name: Harisah
data.gender_notes: Harisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Harisa' meaning 'gift', 'reward' or 'bounty'. In Islamic tradition, the name Harisah symbolizes the idea of being given blessings and gifts from Allah. The name Harisah carries the meaning “Gifted, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Harisah usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with the blessings of Allah.
data.etymology: Harisah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harisah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حريرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحريرة اسم مشتق من الحرص على الشيء، وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الاهتمام بالخير والصلاح والفلاح. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الحرص على الخير في سورة الفاتحة، حيث يقول الله تعالى: "اهدنا الصراط المستقيم".

in_hindi.name: हरीरा
in_hindi.meaning: भलाई और अच्छाई की इच्छा रखने वाली
